visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer with blonde hair, wearing a white oversized jacket and light-colored pants, stands at the center of a brightly lit stage. He holds a microphone and gestures with his free hand. Behind him, a massive screen displays a vibrant, surreal 3D animation featuring a large, blue, one-eyed monster and a colorful path through a dreamlike forest. (2) A static shot displays a large promotional poster mounted on a black metal truss structure. The poster features a male figure and the text 'NOBODY CAN FLY'. The background shows an indoor arena setting with technical equipment. (3) The scene shifts back to the stage where the performer is active. The background animation has changed to blue-toned classical statues and swirling abstract patterns. Numerous green light sticks wave in the dark foreground, held by an invisible audience. (4) A wide, high-angle shot captures the entire interior of a massive stadium. Thousands of fans are waving green light sticks in unison, creating a sea of glowing light. The distant stage is illuminated with colorful graphics and strobe lights. (5) Closer shots of the band members follow: a drummer with blue hair is seen playing energetically behind a drum kit, and the main singer is shown playing a black electric guitar while singing into a microphone. The stage lighting transitions between warm orange, intense red, and cool blue hues, synchronized with the performance. (6) The singer bows to the audience as the lights dim, and the large screens transition to a final message, concluding the highlight reel.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-energy promotional highlight reel for the band 831 (八三夭) and their 'NOBODY CAN FLY' concert tour. By combining vibrant stage visuals, massive crowd shots, and energetic live audio performances, it aims to celebrate the successful event and build emotional connection and anticipation among fans for their next appearance.
